purpose: Prospective reporting policy for the remaining 72 already-planned character/effect comparisons. No new generation settings, methods, prompts or fitted ranking weights.
exposure: Both identities were qualified and all 72 calibration cases were rendered, technically audited and sparsely inspected before this freeze. Four calibration similarity reports and two selected all-frame/waveform follow-ups are exposed. No held-out history exists in either execution plan at the pre-freeze check. Held-out means new prompt/seed outputs, not unseen identities or a double-blind human trial.
technical_gates: Revalidate both frozen execution plans, full 144-case disjoint union, installed asset identities and all prerequisite hashes before starting. Confirm all 72 calibration histories and zero held-out histories at first launch.

Run only existing local 8189, serial GPU execution, exact prepared profile and graph. Existing intent/receipt/WebSocket handling remains authoritative. Stop new submissions if unrelated work is queued; do not interrupt it or start a second server.

Audit every original output: exact executed graph, 124 decoded frames, dimensions/fps, video integrity and stereo audio. Keep full-scale flags, failed or incomplete cases explicit. No replacing unfavorable outputs or using favorable seeds as substitutes.

Create four independent 18-candidate method-blinded reviews; verify full decoded AV equality and metadata removal. Retain original media, creator references and matched character-only anchors without gain, timing or frame edits.

visual_review.initial_scope: All 72 held-out candidates: same 21 chronological 4-fps samples per clip and both creator references. Save public-ID observations for each complete 18-case block before opening its method mapping or any numerical comparison.
visual_review.full_frame_scope: All 72 candidates, including every control and method, receive all-124-frame chronological inspection with unchanged stereo waveform timelines. Scope is fixed before outcomes, not selected by apparent success or failure. Save a separate detailed observation record before method unblinding. Automated preparation may read private keys but must not expose their mapping to the observer before records are saved.
visual_review.ambiguous_event_rule: Inspect original-resolution contiguous event frames when small thumbnails obscure a contact or extra movement. Retain initial ambiguity and inspected frame ranges. If still occluded, report indeterminate contact/handedness rather than inventing a precise event. Do not count waveform peaks as visual actions.
visual_review.identity: Describe coarse reference features and visible fine face/head/horn differences across poses. Compare both creator reference and matched character-only baseline. Report subject absence, cropping, small size, shadow, pose and self-occlusion; do not silently drop hard frames. Background, clothing, lighting and pose changes alone are not identity failure.
visual_review.combat: Separate attempted punch cycles from confirmed bag contact; inspect specified left-jab then right-straight ordering where anatomy/perspective allows, guard recovery, total action count, glove-lowering ending and bag response. Exactly two action bursts is not exactly two punches. Preserve character-only/effect-only faults so they are not automatically attributed to merging.
visual_review.cinema: Separately inspect library/book presence, initial downward gaze, gaze lift, small closed-mouth smile, hand placement on the closed blue book, wardrobe and full-head/shoulder visibility. Style quality is not equivalent to stronger saturation/contrast or a changed rendering medium.
visual_review.temporal: Record observed feature switches, deformations, occlusions, frame discontinuities and action ordering with frame ranges. All-frame still inspection is not continuous-motion playback; do not claim otherwise.

audio_policy.waveform: Retain decoded stereo PTS, continuous 5-ms min/max and RMS diagnostics and anonymous energy candidates. Compare visible event windows to energy groups descriptively; maxima are not sound labels, onsets, exact counts or synchronization quality scores.
audio_policy.listening: No assistant listening or human AV rating is presumed. Sound identity, unwanted speech/music, realism and perceptual synchronization remain unassessed unless actually reviewed by an audio-capable path or a supplied human rating. Record provenance and keep any later human labels separate from assistant frame observations.
audio_policy.no_composite: No weighted composite identity/effect/AV score and no fabricated zero for missing audio judgments. Technical amplitude flags are not preferences or proof of audible clipping.

automatic_similarity.reason: Calibration invalidates this head-patch cosine as an autonomous fine-identity ranking signal: Sully CT can nearly tie additive despite changed face/horns, and Sully/Cinema seed 32 base nearly ties additive while exceeding character-only despite a visibly different design. Retain all calibration results as negative evaluator evidence. Do not widen the calibration-only recipes or fit new masks/thresholds on held-out outputs.

shipping_decision.default_preservation: Keep disconnected experimental behavior and current scoring weights/ranking formula unchanged. No automatic NP/CT preference or wardrobe-only bonus from these calibration results.
shipping_decision.quality_evidence: Report matched per-pair/per-seed trade-offs and all controls. Two subjects with correlated frames do not support population-level significance. A method is not an overall AV winner when sound has not been judged, or when identity preservation discards the requested second effect.
shipping_decision.f08: Candidate inactive-field deduplication is a separate reproduced correctness/search-efficiency experiment. Do not rewrite these nine baseline arms or claim that a replacement candidate improves quality. Any opt-in implementation needs unchanged-disconnected regression tests, active-parameter distinction tests, actual tensor equivalence and controlled efficiency measurements; changed winners require a separately recorded prospective render comparison.
shipping_decision.completion: This freeze or generation completion does not complete the overall goal. Finish all declared evaluations, tested fixes and efficiency checks, then give an evidence-backed shipping recommendation including unassessed AV dimensions and negative NP/CT/evaluator findings. No commit, push, version bump or installed-node replacement without separate approval.
